name: Iris
source:
A haughty waitress who has an admirer or two. She lives in Room 216 (Success), directly across from [url=/c19742]Kyle's[/url] room.

[Spoiler]Her conflict is centered around the disappearance of her older half-sister Grace Woodward, and her own inner feelings of inadequacy. Iris is also the half-aunt of [url=/c149569]Melissa Woodward[/url], although neither of them know this.[/spoiler]

[Based on the [url=https://cing.fandom.com/wiki/Iris]wiki[/url]]
